skonester_db_artificial_forest_district = {
	primary_building = db_artificial_forest_01
	type = duchy_capital
	can_be_replaced = yes
	background = { reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/fp1_steward_study.dds" }
	is_enabled = {
		can_have_duchy_capital_building_trigger = yes
		county.duchy.holder = county.holder
	}
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct_potential = {
		building_requirement_tribal = no
		building_forest_requirement = yes
		building_requirement_castle_city_church = { LEVEL = 01 }
	}
	can_construct = {
		scope:holder = {
			culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_prosperity_01
			}
		}
	}
}

skonester_db_gigantic_idol_district = {
	primary_building = db_gigantic_idol_01
	type = duchy_capital
	can_be_replaced = yes
	background = { reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/fp1_steward_study.dds" }
	is_enabled = {
		can_have_duchy_capital_building_trigger = yes
		county.duchy.holder = county.holder
		scope:holder = {
			has_government = tribal_government
		}
		NOT = {
			OR = {
				scope:holder = {
					religion = religion:islam_religion
				}
				scope:holder = {
					religion = religion:christianity_religion
				}
				scope:holder = {
					religion = religion:judaism_religion
				}				
			}
		}
	}
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct_potential = {
		building_requirement_tribal = yes
		has_building_or_higher = tribe_01
	}
	can_construct = {
		scope:holder = {
			culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_plenary_assemblies
			}
		}
	}
}

	primary_building = db_statue_horse_01
	type = duchy_capital
	can_be_replaced = yes

		OR = {
			scope:holder = {

	}
	can_construct = {
		scope:holder = {
			culture = {

skonester_db_tomb_ancestors_district = {
	primary_building = db_tomb_ancestors_01
	type = duchy_capital
	can_be_replaced = yes
	background = { reference = "gfx/interface/illustrations/event_scenes/fp1_steward_study.dds" }
	is_enabled = {
		can_have_duchy_capital_building_trigger = yes
		county.duchy.holder = county.holder
	}
	show_disabled = yes
	can_construct_potential = {
		OR = {
			AND = {
				building_requirement_tribal = yes
				has_building_or_higher = tribe_01
			}
			AND = {
				building_requirement_tribal = no
				building_requirement_castle_city_church = { LEVEL = 01 }
				scope:holder = {
					faith = { has_tenet = tenet_ancestor_worship }
				}
			}
		}
	}
	can_construct = {
		scope:holder = {
			culture = {
				has_innovation = innovation_plenary_assemblies
			}
		}
	}
}
